02 — Details Matter

Details Matter

A.The wordmark is the logo

Every piece runs on one thing: big, loud wordmarks in hot orange-red — or clean white on the snapback — readable across the boardwalk.

B.Born in a vintage rack

RAG3VERSE didn’t launch in a warehouse — it launched inside Route 66 Vintage at Venice Beach, next to the leathers and the antiques. The photos on this page are the proof.

C.Bigger than any one person

RAG3VERSE isn’t a face — it’s a universe. The clothes are just the uniform: built to outgrow any single name and carry the whole world being built around them. Chaos in, creativity out.

D.A signal you can spot

The wordmark cuts through the noise — big, loud, readable from half a block away. Wear it, and the signal moves with you.
